notice: Light news day — several of yesterday's biggest stories already ran in issue 36, so this edition leans on fresh tools, open-source and Italy coverage.

lead.title: xAI's Imagine Video 1.5 adds references and native 1080p output
lead.summary: xAI's best video model now accepts text, image and voice references, can generate a clip from a prompt alone, and produces native 1080p output. The update widens Imagine Video's reach from single-prompt generation toward reference-driven, controllable video production.

top_stories.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
top_stories.summary: A $13M Series A led by Seligman Ventures with Sierra Ventures and 3one4 Capital pushes the low-latency real-time voice intelligence startup past $21M total funding.

top_stories.title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for AI for private credit managers
top_stories.summary: Ellis AI emerges from stealth with a $10M seed backed by First Round, 645 Ventures, Khosla, Thrive and others to apply AI to private credit management.

items.title: LMSYS ships cleaner quantization stack in SGLang for Qwen3-30B-A3B
items.summary: A new quantization-stack blog compresses Qwen3-30B-A3B from 61GB to 21.6GB using W4A4_W8A8 with a minimal GSM8K drop (91.1% → 89.4%) plus latency gains, expanding support to AWQ, GPTQ and more backends.

items.title: Qwen-UI-Agent technical report: next-gen GUI agents
items.summary: A new Qwen-UI-Agent technical report focuses on next-generation GUI agents for real-world tasks, with agentic tooling built on Qwen for UI understanding and control.

items.title: Explorative Modeling: a third pretraining axis and end-to-end generation
items.summary: A new paper, 'Explorative Modeling', proposes unlocking a third pretraining axis and end-to-end generation — a fresh research direction surfacing in the open-source timeline.

items.title: GAI – a Go runtime for typed, tool-using LLM agents
items.summary: An open-source Go runtime designed for building typed, tool-using LLM agents, launched as a Show HN on Hacker News.

items.title: Sanitizer – strip sensitive data from documents locally before an LLM
items.summary: A local-first tool that strips sensitive data from documents before they reach an LLM, keeping PII off external systems.

items.title: Shellphone – MCP extension to link Claude Chat and Claude Code
items.summary: An MCP extension that bridges Claude Chat and Claude Code, letting agents talk to each other, published to npm as a Show HN.

items.title: Vinv – IDE plug-in that finds and fixes bugs, dead code and perf issues
items.summary: An IDE plug-in that automatically locates and fixes bugs, dead code and performance issues in your codebase.

items.title: Revismart closes first €500K pre-seed to bring generative AI to legal review
items.summary: The Reggio Emilia startup, spun out of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, closed the first tranche of a €500K pre-seed to build its generative AI platform for legal and accounting review, half of it from 40Jemz Ventures.

items.title: Italian startups raised €102.97M in July 2026, led by AI and deep-tech rounds
items.summary: Italian startups raised €102.97M across 18 capital increases in July, bringing the seven-month total to €719.66M, per a Repubblica tally — topped by MDOTM's €27M, Young Group's €22.5M and Circular Materials' €11.8M.
